title: A Giraffe's Blood Pressure Is Double Yours. It Needs It

scenes.text: A giraffe's blood pressure is twice as high as yours.
That heart has to push blood up a neck taller than a grown man.
Readings average around 200 to 250, more than double most mammals.
Long legs help too. They lift the heart closer to the head.
Twice yours. And it has to be.

description:
A giraffe's blood pressure averages 200 to 250 mmHg, more than twice that of most mammals.
Its heart weighs about 25 pounds and must push blood up a long neck against gravity. Research suggests long legs help by lifting the heart closer to the head.
What animal do you think has the toughest body? Tell us.
first_comment: A giraffe's heart weighs about 25 pounds. What other animal do you think has the most extreme body?
